_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: the ML chapter's shadow returning — bias is not a bug but the limit trained INTO the machine; experienced from inside the compression, not surveyed from above. The god's-eye view is itself the bias.

Deleuze refused-then-reworked: adjusting reconnection probability makes hierarchy-vs-multiplicity a concrete topological CHOICE. We can't escape history (the tree), but reconnection lets us grow sideways — the map becomes mesh.

voltage.why: the feminist counter to Deleuzian escape — not a line of flight OUT but an archive we build ourselves: incomplete panels that cross-reference each other, cycling without a master text. The commons instead of the exit.

the book's final gesture — QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t) glowing whole after the whole walk; not a proof that closes but a formula that stays open, the residual ΔE the generative dark spot the book leaves lit.
